items.zh: 新增在线 Lua 插件编辑器：自建插件零编译，保存即热更重载
items.en: New in-browser Lua plugin editor: author plugins with zero compilation, hot-reload on save

items.zh: luahost 补齐任务契约（RunTask/ListTaskCapabilities），Lua 插件可声明并执行任务
items.en: LuaHost now covers the task contract (RunTask/ListTaskCapabilities) for Lua plugins

items.zh: 修复全站时间 8 小时偏差：落库统一 UTC，展示按本地时区
items.en: Fix the 8-hour time offset: timestamps stored in UTC, displayed in local timezone

items.zh: 修复 lua 插件市场误判未安装与 installed_at 落成 0001-01-01
items.en: Fix Lua plugins misdetected as uninstalled and installed_at saved as 0001-01-01
